mitigation_measures: manage up-to-date antivirus signatures and engines
have all the operating system patches up-to-date
impair File and Printer sharing services
limit the users’ ability to install and run non-essential software applications
practice caution while opening e-mail attachments
allow a personal firewall on agency workstations
impair unnecessary services on agency workstations and servers
browse for and remove suspicious e-mail attachments
watch the users’ web browsing modes
practice caution while using removable media
examine all the software that has been downloaded from the internet
manage situational awareness of the most advanced threats
